title: Read a reduce/reduce conflict grammar
description: A reduce/reduce conflict gives one table cell two possible reductions. You can trace the shared token definitions that create the competing interpretations here.

steps.description: The file declares ID and begins its grammar rules.
s has two alternatives: a followed by b, or c followed by d.
Each of the four nonterminals derives ID. After the first ID, both a and c offer completed reductions.
